sources.title: Billbergia pallidiflora
sources.clean: Billbergia pallidiflora is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. This species is native to Central America (Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua) and western Mexico (as far north as Sinaloa).
